crm_notes: Summary: ZenPulse builds in-game conversational agents and personalization middleware for live multiplayer titles. Extremely latency-sensitive (player-facing), cost-sensitive at scale.
Key ask: deterministic sub-100ms end-to-end response for short chat replies (100-200 tokens), p95 token latency target <25ms for model path. Need guidance on batching/caching/quantization tradeoffs.
Model preferences: prefer open models (Llama 2 / Mistral-family) with ability to run quantized weights; willing to test 70B->q4 and fallback to 13B q4o for spikes.
Routing: want smart routing — low-latency pool for premium users, cost-tiered pool for background personalization. Need automatic fallback during capacity pressure without visible degradation.
Security: EU data residency for EU players; SSO + audit logs mandatory; KMS integration for key management. Evaluating Private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem edge collectors).

Cost target: aggressive — want model unit economics that keep cost per MAU incremental < $0.50/month for personalization features; benchmarking should include token-level cost projections (batching impact).
Quote from CTO on 3/12: 'If we can push p95 latency down and keep costs linear with QPS we can rollout to two live titles this year.'
AE notes: Jordan did feature walkthrough 2026-02-24; Priya ran initial perf microbench on single-GPU instance 2026-03-02 (see drive).
Risk: quantization artifacts — tone/polite/identity handling matter for moderation; need eval harness to detect hallucination/regression after q4 quantization.
